versionDecision: Compatible save-boundary and event-presentation fixes; patch release. Product version does not change the save schema.
mainChanges: Reject newly encoded saves beyond either the existing 5,000,000-character decode limit or the 5,000,000-byte UTF-8 file limit before archive/main/mirror writes. Preserve the previous playable snapshot on failure.
Apply the same size guard to migrated imports before writing legacy or current archives, while retaining original expected-snapshot conflict checks and exact historical rescue encoding.

Offering and relic loom describe the already registered item and its actual protection reason. They never silently select another item; legitimate unnamed objects display a fallback name with their original ID.
Bloodwell explains that the recorded 20% maximum-HP cost was fixed at room entry and still requires current HP strictly greater than that cost after equipment changes.
Memorywell warns before confirmation that resetting HP talents can reduce current HP and reallocating them will not heal it.
runtimeScopeClarification: Only storage.js and encounters.js change behavior/presentation; views.js contains exactly two release-label replacements. README, package.json and index.html provide the matching 5.6.1 release metadata.
regressionGuards: Save schema 5, all persistent keys, V1–V4 migrations, original item IDs, complete snapshots, pending/resolved results and RNG semantics remain.
All 36 original test files plus one fixture, all 53 original scripts, all 12 CSS files and all 8 offline font/document/license files remain byte-identical to input.
Engine, equipment, deep-rules, catalog, probability, rarity gates, prices, talents, transaction coordinator, renderer, motion, effects and timeline are byte-identical to input.
Six-room floors, manual dice up to six, one weapon/armor/three relics, one currency and eight rarities remain. No runtime dependencies, new runtime images or remote services added.

deepEconomy.limits: Both versions replay the same 32 journeys, not 64 independent samples. At eight memorywell starts, full balanced/resonance/pursuit/luck templates share final talent vectors; full defense invests more in undying and differs. Automatic success does not establish human balance.

browser.countingRule: Separate overlapping functional groups, native stress cases, lifecycle injection and performance samples; do not sum them as unique tests.

nativeSizeBoundary.baseline: Oversized primary becomes undecodable and reload has no Continue.
nativeSizeBoundary.current: Rejects before any writes; state/RNG and every existing key remain exact, native export equals the imported raw bytes, reload continues the old state.
nativeSizeBoundary.nativeQuotaCaveat: The near-5MB fixture fits primary but not a second full mirror in this native context. Existing mirror-capacity warning is retained; do not claim two copies were present in this case.
nativeSizeBoundary.migrationBaseline: Writes the immutable original archive before a native quota failure; existing small active run survives.
nativeSizeBoundary.migrationCurrent: Rejects before any archive/main/mirror mutation and preserves the existing small run.
nativeSizeBoundary.fixtureType: Synthetic valid extension-field stress, not natural private player data.

performance.stageObservation: data-fx-kind metadata, not positive-alpha drawing or GPU completion

storage.limits: Fixed B then C pairs, no randomization or order balancing. End-to-end conversion/check/encode/storage/render time is not an isolated TextEncoder or physical-disk measurement.

performance.inventoryOpenPercentileMethod: Sorted value at floor((n - 1) * p); 119.7/68.0 are fixed-rank p50, not the arithmetic median of 12 samples.

packaging.selfReferenceRule: Manifest excludes itself; the final ZIP bytes/SHA/count remain external, never embedded as its own hash.
packaging.finalArchiveRule: After adding a code-identical candidate receipt, build one final ZIP and verify/extract it again with syntax, 21-file core tests and an owned HTTP resource server.
packaging.finalIdentityLocation: External final-extraction receipt and final delivery response; not this candidate identity.

openRisks: P2 rendering: the 30-window software diagnostic retains multi-second RAF gaps and misses some 4K full target-stage metadata. Renderer remains input-identical; no FPS or hardware 4K claim.

P2 storage latency: complete synchronous snapshots remain. The measured 12 paired fixed-fixture write-return differences are all positive; optimize only while preserving full expected checks and atomic save behavior.

P2 deep economy: all 32 automatic journeys complete with no deaths; some complete memorywell templates converge, while full defense remains different. This does not establish human balance or justify immediate price/difficulty changes.

P2 large imported saves: successful file-format checks do not guarantee space for two native copies. Existing quota and mirror warnings remain meaningful; format limits are not browser-capacity promises.
NOT_TESTED: physical GPU/4K, real phone/pen, external screen reader, Windows double-click, audio listening, actual OS suspension and physical power loss.
nextRoundPriorities: Controlled real-GPU/software rendering diagnosis with complete fixed sample retention
Deep economy and meaningful 200+ opportunity costs before changing rewards or prices
Large-save latency improvements that preserve complete expected comparisons and archives
Natural long-play event comprehension and outlier equipment names
Physical-device accessibility, input, audio and launcher checks
evidenceNotes: All claimed round06 gates are fresh. Round05 and earlier evidence is retained under historical paths and is not counted again.

The actual indexed renderer candidate was reverted after six measured fresh-process windows showed no stable benefit. The initial ESM setup failure occurred before browser measurements and is preserved.

The final 326-case suite restarted after the release footer label was finalized. The interrupted development run is explicitly excluded; two subsequently added browser QA scripts received separate syntax/native execution checks.
Three storage-latency launch/setup failures all occurred before timed sampling. The fixed 26-row schedule then completed once with every slow sample retained.
Author and independent reviewer roles are distinguished in INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md. Event presentation tests and data fingerprints are separate; resolved historical text is not retroactively rewritten.
An original imagegen concept was actually explored and rejected as a runtime bitmap. Only six compressed real browser screenshots are added as small audit evidence.
Source paths or hashes inside raw evidence are provenance records; portable scripts and final summaries needed for the next round are included in this ZIP.

Final handoff review corrected an overbroad template-convergence sentence before release. Defense differs by undying allocation; this was a documentation-only clarification, with all 147 frozen files unchanged. The archive was rebuilt and required a new final extraction gate.
